cleaner.label: GPU shader cache
cleaner.description: Rebuildable shader and graphics-driver caches. Close games and 3D software.

option.label: DirectX shader cache
option.description: Removes the DirectX cache. Close games and 3D programs: shaders will be recompiled and may be temporarily slower.

option.label: NVIDIA DX and OpenGL cache
option.description: Removes the NVIDIA caches: close games and GPU apps; the caches will be regenerated and the next launch may be slower.

option.label: AMD DX and OpenGL cache
option.description: Removes the AMD caches: close games and GPU apps; the caches will be regenerated and the next launch may be slower.

option.label: CUDA compile cache
option.description: Removes the CUDA JIT compile cache (ComputeCache). Close programs that use CUDA: kernels will be recompiled and the first launch may be slower.
